decision.description: What was decided: quick (with a target) or agentic.

candidates.description: The search matches that were offered beside the map.

dock.description: The tab to open, when the target is one the backend can address (a screen, an entity, an app).

address.description: The dock address navigated, query included: /dock/search?q=widget.

prompt.description: What the assistant is asked instead, when nothing is opened.
